name: Prompt template copy
oneLiner: a glass prompt template card: each blank field types in its value and turns solid, the counter ticks to all filled, a cursor presses Copy and the button flips to a green Copied with a pulse
say: when the speaker gives a prompt or template to steal ('here is the exact prompt', 'just swap in your topic and copy it'): the blanks fill as they name them, Copied lands on 'copy it' or 'steal this'
